abstract: We report a case of a 33-year-old nulliparous woman who, following a short prodromal illness, experienced a series of psychiatric and behavioural symptoms. These included states of terror, insomnia, delirium, self-harm and suicidal ideation, facial dyskinesias, verbigeration, cognitive impairment, reduced responsiveness, violence and paranoia. A diagnosis of anti-N-methyl-d-aspartate (NMDAR) encephalitis was made 50 days after symptom onset. Early tumour removal is associated with an improved prognosis and a laparoscopic oophorectomy was performed following detection of a dermoid cyst. Within 24 hours of the operation there was marked improvement in cognitive function and appetite.
abstract_ja: 本症例は、33歳の未経産女性の報告である。短い前駆症状に続き、恐怖状態、不眠、せん妄、自傷行為、自殺念慮、顔面ジストニア、語句の反復、認知機能障害、反応性の低下、暴力、妄想などの精神症状と行動症状が現れた。症状発現から50日後に抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。早期の腫瘍摘出が予後改善につながるため、類皮嚢腫が検出された後に腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術が施行された。手術後24時間以内に認知機能と食欲の著明な改善が認められた。
